text: Fill in the key term blanked out in each sentence about India's National Health Programmes.
questions: India's tuberculosis elimination programme NI-KSHAY uses the *DOTS/Directly Observed Treatment Short-course:Supervised drug administration strategy ensuring treatment adherence* strategy for directly observed treatment and GeneXpert for rapid molecular diagnosis.

India was certified polio-free in *2014:The last wild poliovirus case in India was detected in January 2011* through the Pulse Polio Programme administering bivalent OPV during National Immunisation Days.

*NACO/National AIDS Control Organisation:The nodal organisation under the Ministry of Health for HIV/AIDS control* implements the National AIDS Control Programme, providing free antiretroviral therapy and operating integrated counselling and testing centres across India.

The *NVBDCP/National Vector Borne Disease Control Programme:Covers mosquito-borne, sandfly-borne and tick-borne diseases nationally* coordinates prevention and control of six vector-borne diseases including malaria, dengue, kala-azar and Japanese encephalitis.

Under the NI-KSHAY programme, previously known as *RNTCP/Revised National Tuberculosis Control Programme:The earlier name for India's national TB programme before rebranding*, India set a tuberculosis elimination target ahead of the global SDG 2030 deadline.
